summary: BlackRock Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 107,475.86 unregistered Institutional Class common shares to feeder vehicles for $2,540,654, priced at approximately $23.64 per share, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The Fund declared a regular quarterly distribution of $0.1783 per share across Institutional, Class S, and Class D shares, payable September 29, 2026 to holders of record, with payment October 28, 2026. NAV per share was $23.64 as of August 31, 2026. This is routine fund capital and distribution activity, not a special situation.
